rows.note: Use 定力 as the all-purpose noun when poise means staying calm and unflustered under pressure.

example.english: Even under so much pressure, they can keep their poise; that is truly impressive.

rows.note: Use 平衡 as the all-purpose noun for physical or figurative balance and stability.

example.english: Even standing at the bow of the boat, they can still maintain their poise.

rows.note: Use 姿態 for a person's physical bearing or posture, especially in an aesthetic or descriptive context.

example.english: When she walked into the venue, her elegant poise made everyone look at her.
